info.name: HustleHub Part 2 - Member 1 Authentication and Gigs
info.description: Run the complete collection in order. Creates three test accounts and tests only gigs created during this run. Credentials and tokens are generated or stored as local run variables. Set expiredToken locally before running. It must be a correctly signed token whose expiry is in the past. Never put JWT_SECRET in Postman.

item.name: API health and initialise test accounts

exec: pm.test('Generic login error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password.'));
pm.test('Safe expired-token response', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid or expired token.'));
pm.test('Created Gig is in own list', () => pm.expect(gigs.some(g => g._id === pm.variables.get('gigId'))).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Every Gig belongs to this account', () => pm.expect(gigs.every(g => g.freelancer === pm.variables.get('ownerId'))).to.eql(true));

item.name: Second Freelancer cannot see owner Gig in own list

exec: pm.test('Other owner Gig excluded', () => pm.expect(gigs.some(g => g._id === pm.variables.get('gigId'))).to.eql(false));
pm.test('Correct description', () => pm.expect(gig.description).to.eql('Temporary service created by the Member 1 API tests.'));
pm.test('Title updated', () => pm.expect(gig.title).to.eql('POE API Test Gig Updated'));
